d5m1-l1.lead: A lawsuit is a **highly structured, court-mandated process**: miss a deadline or misfile a document, and the court can dismiss the case.

concepts.text: Pleadings: track service and draft files; discovery: gather data, prep the client; trial prep: **coordinate schedules, final medicals**
Once suit is filed, paperwork stops being admin tracking: a **missing or misfiled document** can jeopardize the trial
Interrogatories are written questions under oath, RFPs demand documents, RFAs demand admit or deny: all **run on strict deadlines**
Every filing by either side creates a docket entry, and **its clock runs** whether or not the email reached you

framework.title: The Litigation Lifecycle: Where You Fit In
head: Phase
What happens
Your role
rows: Pleadings
File the Complaint, serve the defendant, receive the Answer
Track **service timelines** and draft the initial files
Discovery
Interrogatories, Requests for Production, depositions
Calendar every response, gather the data, meet the client
Trial prep
Expert disclosures, motion practice, trial or settlement
Coordinate schedules and update the final medicals
framework.note: Discovery is where you spend most of your litigation time; every phase runs on the court's deadlines, not an adjuster's.

d5m1-l2.lead: Trial preparation is the stage where you **compile the final puzzle pieces**, so the attorney walks into court fully armed.

concepts.text: Both sides must lay their cards on the table; it is where Case Managers spend **most of their litigation time**
An oral interview under oath, recorded by a court reporter; you own **the logistics, not the testimony**
Litigation can take 1 to 3 years, so records and bills are rerun to show **the total cost** of injury
Measurable checks you audit weekly, like a server assigned within 48 hours, so a slipping file **shows before it fails**

framework.title: Phase 3: Trial and Mediation Preparation

steps.label: The Final Run
steps.text: Litigation can take 1 to 3 years: rerun records from **every provider**, never the pre-lit package

steps.label: Subpoena Management
steps.text: Draft trial subpoenas for the witnesses Atty. Thorne names, so they legally appear

steps.label: Trial Binder Organization
steps.text: Exhibits from the litigation file, indexed and tabbed for the attorney at the counsel table

framework.note: The Scheduling Order sets every date: pin it to the front of the file, with 30-, 14- and 7-day alerts.

d5m2-l1.lead: Property Damage is **a cornerstone of civil litigation**: the law's mechanism for making an owner financially whole after negligence harms their property.

concepts.text: In suit, PD can be **definitive evidence of injury** or the defense's most formidable tool against it
Special damages are quantifiable losses; general damages are subjective. Every PD figure is special, **proved by documents**
How much the defendant owes is among the **most heavily litigated** PD questions, so courts apply set formulas
Pre-loss market value minus post-loss value; the **lesser-of rule** weighs it against repair cost, capping a Total Loss

framework.title: Types of Damages You Can Recover
head: Type of damage
What it covers
On a PD claim
rows: Economic (special)
Quantifiable financial losses, **proved by documents**
Repair, tow and storage, rental, Loss of Use, Diminished Value
Non-economic (general)
Subjective losses: pain and suffering, emotional distress, loss of consortium
Claimed on the injury side, not the property side
Punitive (exemplary)
Punishes egregious, reckless or intentional misconduct and deters others
Conduct such as DUI; none is pleaded on this file
framework.note: The goal is not a windfall: restore the owner to the financial position held before the incident.

d5m2-l2.lead: The law measures property at **fair market value**, so what a repaired car still loses is a market loss, proved with market evidence.

concepts.text: Standard law values property at market; special value to an owner is **an exception, not the rule**
A carrier formula is claims practice, **not a legal measure**; an appraisal built on market data tests it
Get the carrier's position and inputs in writing: only **a basis on paper** can be answered with stronger evidence
In suit, a Subpoena Duces Tecum **compels a non-party's records**; a blanket request invites a Motion to Quash

framework.title: Calculating the Value of the Claim
head: Measure
How courts apply it
Its limit
rows: The lesser-of rule
The lesser of repair cost or the drop in market value
Costs more to fix than it was worth: a Total Loss
Diminished Value
Market value a car still loses after a proper repair
Many courts add it to repair, kept under pre-loss value
Special value
No market (an heirloom): some courts use actual value to the owner
Sentimental value is still excluded: **an exception, not the rule**
framework.note: Every measure starts from fair market value; confirm the governing rule with Atty. Thorne.

d5m3-l1.lead: A deposition can shape a litigated case's outcome: the attorney owns the legal strategy, while you prepare the client **operationally and psychologically**.

concepts.text: Before any prep meeting, review the file for **what the defense will exploit**, so Atty. Thorne meets it first
The defense compares testimony with signed answers and records; any mismatch **reads as concealment**, so counsel sees it first
Clients expect a TV courtroom drama; showing **the real, ordinary process** calms them without any prediction
Defense counsel reports to the carrier how the client will strike a jury: **presentation feeds that report**

framework.title: Preparing Your Client for a Deposition

steps.label: Pre-deposition audit
steps.text: Prior medical history, signed answers, public social media: landmines routed to Atty. Thorne

steps.label: Pillar 1: De-escalate
steps.text: No judge, no jury, no shouting: calm the client with **the process**, never a prediction

steps.label: Pillar 2: Testimony guidelines
steps.text: Pause, tell the truth, stop once answered: drilled on neutral questions only

steps.label: Pillar 3: Dress and demeanor
steps.text: Business casual, nothing flashy; limitations told plainly, never minimized or exaggerated

steps.label: Technology check
steps.text: A computer, camera at eye level, light in front, a quiet private room

steps.label: The day before
steps.text: Confirm date, time and link with the client, Atty. Thorne and the court reporter

framework.note: Atty. Thorne prepares the substance; you prepare the person and the setting.

d5m3-l2.lead: The defense's goal is to make the client **contradict, lose temper or exaggerate**, damaging credibility; general rules protect it, a script cannot.

concepts.text: Defense counsel may ask a very broad range of questions to discover the facts: **wide questions are normal**, not attacks
An estimate rests on what you perceived; a guess claims what you couldn't know: **only the estimate** is honest testimony
A deposition gathers facts for the defense's evaluation; nothing is won there, so **the smallest target** protects the case
An objection is **a formal flag** on the record protecting the witness, not a sign of trouble

framework.title: The 7 Golden Rules for Testifying
head: Rule
What it says
Why it protects
rows: Always tell the absolute truth
A damaged case can be saved; **a lied-about one cannot**
Pause two full seconds, then answer in words
Time to think, a clean transcript, a window to object
Never guess; answer only what was asked, then stop
“I don't know” is a complete answer: the smallest target
Hold the silence; don't try to win
A deposition gathers information; the legal battle is Atty. Thorne's
framework.note: Questions fall into four categories: background, crash mechanics, medical history, daily life. Clients underreport medical history most.

d5m4-l1.lead: Comparative negligence **apportions fault** between the parties; the share charged to the injured person can reduce, or bar, what they recover.

concepts.text: Pure, modified and contributory treat one fault finding differently: **the governing rule**, not the percentage alone, decides reduce or bar
Liability is accepted, partial or denied; recording **its status and source** shows Atty. Thorne what remains contested
Comparative fault concerns the crash; failure to mitigate concerns later care and **trims only avoidable damages**
An index answering each pleaded allegation with **evidence that can come in**, built for Atty. Thorne's analysis

framework.title: The Liability Counter-Package
head: Defense pleaded
What it targets
Evidence that answers
rows: Entered the stop out of turn
Kevin Alvarez's driving, not John's
Ruth Calloway, the doorbell video, the point of impact; EDR corroborates
Unbelted passenger
John's seatbelt use
EDR: belt buckled; EMS: “restrained front-seat passenger”
Failure to mitigate
19 days without visits, 04/02 → 04/21/2026
The A-C-T record: the 04/08 call, extension refused 04/10, evening slots
Causation
The 14-Day Gap; the “degenerative” MRI
The Gap Record: four reasons, EMS neck complaint, Causation Letter
framework.note: Every item carries its source, its authenticating witness and **its chain of custody**; its weight is Atty. Thorne's call.

d5m4-l2.lead: Filing a lawsuit **means nothing until service**: the defendant must be legally notified, or the case stalls and may be dismissed.

concepts.text: Defendants aware of a suit may hide, ignore the door or move; **diligent, logged attempts** prove the effort
A background search of utility, employment and address records that **finds a current address**, run only for permissible purpose
A court-permitted substitute for personal service, such as mail or posting, that **only the attorney can request**
Certified mail leaves **a provable mailing record**; with email, it shows the client was told how to respond

framework.title: The Evading Defendant Protocol

steps.label: Attempts fail
steps.text: Log each attempt's date, time and address; follow up with the server every 5 days

steps.label: Skip-Trace
steps.text: On Atty. Thorne's authority, licensed databases check utility, employment and **active-address records**

steps.label: Vary the windows
steps.text: The server tries early mornings, evenings and weekends where the court's rules allow

steps.label: Alternative service
steps.text: Atty. Thorne may ask the court to permit service by mail or posting

steps.label: Proof of service
steps.text: The signed affidavit of service is filed with the court, never left in email

framework.note: Unserved before the court's deadline, a case can be dismissed: confirm the court's rule.

d5m5-l1.lead: The Net Sheet is **the ultimate transparency tool**: it shows the client where every dollar came from and where it goes.

concepts.text: The attorney's work and costs created the fund, so lienholders contribute **their proportional share** of fees and costs
Carriers audit the file, so the sheet traces **every dollar to its source**, never mixing funds
Fees can differ by stream and stage; tracking **each stream's fee separately** keeps the ledger accurate and explainable
No lien check goes out without a signed letter accepting it as **full and final satisfaction**

framework.title: The BI/UM Master Financial Ledger
head: Net Sheet section
What it records
On a litigated file
rows: Recovery summary
Gross recovery by stream, each with its source
BI tendered at mediation; both UM awards at arbitration
Attorney fees
The fee on each stream, confirmed from the retainer
The **40% tier** once suit is filed
Case expenses
Every advanced cost, each with its receipt
Filing, service, mediation, arbitration, reporter, records, plus pre-suit costs
Provider ledger
Charges, payments, adjustments, balance owed, reduction
Only liens owed; reductions follow the fee actually charged
Net to client
Gross minus fees, costs and reduced liens
Shown line by line before John Doe signs
framework.note: Nothing leaves trust until both UM checks clear and every Payoff Letter is in Documents.
